founder.title: I'll set you up myself.
founder.text: I'm Görkem. I teach face yoga in Berlin and run my own online studio, with live classes, programs and members, so I know where the tools get in the way. Join as a founding creator and you get me: I set up your site, courses and payments with you, one on one, and you can message me whenever you're stuck.

pricing.title: Try Starter free for 14 days.
pricing.text: Build your site, invite students and run live classes before you pay anything. Selling opens when your plan starts. Cancel any time before the first charge.

trial.q: How does the free trial work?
trial.a: Starter is free for 14 days. You add a card when you create your site, and the first charge comes when the trial ends, unless you cancel before in one click from your creator studio. Everything in Starter works except selling: paid courses open when your plan starts, or start it early to sell right away.

technical.a: Not at all. You answer a few plain questions, or ask the assistant in your own words. No code, ever.

payments.a: Selling starts when your plan does. We integrate directly with Stripe: payments go straight to your own Stripe account, so we never hold your money, minus a small transaction fee (8% on Starter, 6% on Pro). You can sell one-time courses or recurring subscriptions.

customDomain.q: Can I use my own domain?
customDomain.a: Yes — on the Pro plan you can connect your own custom domain. And on every paid plan your platform runs fully under your brand: your students never see Contentor.

migration.q: Can I move from another platform?
migration.a: Yes. Most creators rebuild their courses with our builder and invite their students by email within a day. As a founding creator, we'll help you move personally — hands-on and free.

contract.a: No contracts and no commitments. Plans are month to month, and you can cancel any time from your creator studio.

cta.title: Your team is ready when you are.
cta.text: Your site, your students and your payments, looked after from day one.
cta.note: Free for 14 days. Cancel any time.
